Identifiers used to establish whether plotted properties refer to the same physical specimen or batch.

Reported uncertainty retained without assuming SD, SE, or confidence interval when the source does not say.
Property-specific test standard and material direction when reported.
Whether the canonical value was directly reported, inferred from a source scale, or calculated from other fields.
Formal citation year when known.
Online/version-of-record publication date when known.
